title: Getting Started
description: Getting Started documentation for System Caregiver.
overview: This guide covers getting started workflows for System Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Sign In
subtasks.purpose: Establish an authenticated session against a user's role.

steps.title: Enter Email Address
steps.description: Enter your registered email address in the Email field.

steps.title: Enter Password
steps.description: Enter your password in the Password field.

steps.title: Enable Remember Me
steps.description: (Optional) Tick Remember me to keep the email pre-filled on this device.

steps.title: Verify Two-Factor Code
steps.description: If two-factor authentication is enabled on the account, enter the OTP delivered by email and click Verify.

subtasks.title: Forgot Password
subtasks.purpose: Reset the account password when the user cannot sign in.

steps.title: Click Forgot Password
steps.description: Click Forgot Password? on the login page.

steps.title: Submit Account Email
steps.description: Enter the account email and submit.

steps.title: Open Reset Email
steps.description: Open the E-Vitals Password Reset Request email (see 18. Email Logs to audit).

steps.title: Set New Password
steps.description: Follow the reset link and enter a new password meeting the strength criteria.

steps.title: Sign In With New Password
steps.description: Return to the login page and sign in with the new password.
